sections.title: What changes in multiplayer?
sections.intro: Your character, your save, one shared campaign.

quickAnswers.label: LEADER
quickAnswers.text: One leader for the entire campaign.

items.title: Your save stays yours
items.text: Save often. The server does not keep a replacement save for you.

items.title: Follow the campaign leader
items.text: The same leader handles quest dialogue, scenes and items, and enters locations first. Everyone can fight and solve puzzles together.

items.title: Get safe before opening menus
items.text: Our setup does not pause. Step away from danger before choosing gear or a potion.

items.title: Death is a setback
items.text: Normally respawn nearby outdoors or at the indoor entrance. Extra gold-loss penalty: zero. Crime bounties still apply. This exact party setup is not tested yet.

items.title: Master difficulty, shared combat experience
items.text: Master is enforced. Enemies do not automatically scale with party size. Combat experience sharing is on; crafting is separate.

items.title: Protect friendly NPCs
items.text: Player-versus-player damage and killcams are off. Lock-on targets hostiles only. Followers and townsfolk can still be hurt.

blocks.title: Keep this campaign together
blocks.text: Keep the party's characters together in level and quest progress. Use separate characters for other campaigns, including smaller-party nights. Finish Helgen offline before connecting.

sections.title: Build your character
sections.intro: Eighteen skills, no fixed classes. Better Vanilla Perks changes trees; Imperious replaces racial packages.

quickAnswers.label: CHOICE
quickAnswers.text: Every race can learn every skill.

blocks.title: Eighteen skills
rows: Alchemy
Alchemist strengthens crafted potions and poisons; Snakeblood grants poison resistance.
Alchemist adds poison damage to weapon attacks; Snakeblood adds waterbreathing; Poisoner makes melee poison doses last longer.
Alteration
Novice through Master perks reduce spell costs; Magic Resistance provides separate magic defense.
Novice Alteration adds poison resistance; Apprentice adds frost resistance, Adept fire, Expert shock, and Master disease resistance.
Archery
Overdraw raises bow damage; Power Shot adds stagger; Steady Hand slows time while zooming.

Overdraw adds armor penetration and longer arrow poisons; Power Shot adds penetration; Bullseye adds critical damage and disarming. Quarantined (don't use yet): the whole Steady Hand branch, starting at Archery 40.
Block
Shield Wall improves blocking; Quick Reflexes slows time while blocking a power attack.

Shield Wall becomes Iron Will, adding unarmed damage. Strong Reflexes rank 1 halves power-attack damage when shield-blocking; rank 2 adds slowdown. Quarantined (don't use yet): Strong Reflexes rank 2, Block 50. Rank 1, Block 30, is allowed.
Conjuration
Summoner increases casting distance. Twin Souls allows two summons. Elemental Potency strengthens atronachs. An atronach is a summoned elemental spirit.

Summoner and Puppeteer add summon slots; Twin Souls adds two. Staff of the Atronach strengthens certain spells. Potent atronachs and thralls use Better Vanilla Perks' strength. One active summon per player. Quarantined (don't use yet): corpse raising and Dark Souls 2 explosions.
Destruction
Augmented Flames, Frost and Shock add equal damage bonuses; Rune Master increases placement range.
Augmented Flames/Frost/Shock rank 1 adds 20/30/40% damage and reduces spell costs; Rune Master also doubles rune capacity.
Enchanting
Enchanter strengthens new enchantments; Soul Siphon recharges weapons from creature kills.
Enchanter also recharges weapons from nearby kills; Corpus Enchanter strengthens additional enchantments; Soul Siphon stacks with Enchanter.
Heavy Armor
Juggernaut raises armor rating; Well Fitted needs heavy armor on head, chest, hands and feet.
Juggernaut adds material-specific arrow, stagger or magic protection. Well Fitted and Matching Set need three pieces, freeing your helmet choice.
Illusion
Novice Illusion reduces spell cost; Quiet Casting requires the Animage and Kindred Mage path.
Novice Illusion adds arrow avoidance. Quiet Casting needs 50 Illusion or Sneak, with no earlier perks, and works while sneaking. Enemy-control spells do not control players.
Light Armor
Agile Defender raises armor rating; Custom Fit requires light armor on head, chest, hands and feet.
Agile Defender adds material-specific benefits, including cheaper power attacks or stagger resistance. Custom Fit and Matching Set need only three pieces.
Lockpicking
Novice through Master Locks make their lock difficulties easier to pick.
Novice through Master Locks also bypass matching locks with a torch outside combat. Quick Hands no longer needs earlier perks. Quarantined (don't use yet): torch auto-unlock. Use lockpicks manually.
One-Handed
Armsman raises weapon damage; Bladesman adds sword critical hits; Hack and Slash makes axes bleed targets.
Armsman also adds critical chance; Bladesman adds bleeding; Hack and Slash boosts axe power attacks. Flurry speeds main-hand attacks.
Pickpocket
Light Fingers improves theft chances; Extra Pockets adds 100 carrying capacity.
Light Fingers also improves arrow recovery; Extra Pockets gains additional ranks, reaching 300 extra carrying capacity. Coordinate theft and shared loot.
Restoration
Regeneration strengthens healing by 50%; Recovery improves Magicka regeneration.

Regeneration becomes Resurgence, strengthening Restoration by 30%. Mastery perks add Magicka regeneration; Recovery also improves Stamina regeneration. Quarantined (don't use yet): Resurgence until the group's first healer test.
Smithing
Steel Smithing improves steel equipment; Arcane Blacksmith enables tempering enchanted equipment.
Basic Smithing also improves iron; Thalmor Smithing adds Falmer crafting; Arcane Blacksmith improves enchanted gear, leather, hide and faction armor.
Sneak
Backstab boosts one-handed sneak attacks; Shadow Warrior briefly breaks detection when crouching in combat.
Backstab extends bonuses to melee and spell attacks. Shadow Warrior adds night vision and greatsword sneak damage; its second rank adds combat invisibility.
Speech
Haggling improves prices; Intimidation improves threatening dialogue.

Haggling becomes Dragonborn: better prices plus skill-book, summon, steam, drum and merchant benefits. Intimidation also grants Battlecry. Quarantined (don't use yet): Dragonborn rank 4's drum and rank 5's merchant. Rank 2 does not increase our one-summon limit.
Two-Handed
Barbarian raises damage; Limbsplitter makes battleaxes bleed targets; Skullcrusher ignores armor.
Barbarian adds armor penetration and greatsword bleeding; Limbsplitter boosts axe power attacks; Skullcrusher adds damage against undead.
blocks.note: Better Vanilla Perks is part of our collection (revision 6).

blocks.title: Ten races
rows: High Elf
+10 Illusion; +5 Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Enchanting, Restoration; +50 Magicka. Highborn rapidly restores Magicka for one minute.

Level-100 skills improve; low Magicka/Stamina recover faster but weaken defenses; gear weakens, enchantments strengthen. Contingency stores spells for automatic casting. Quarantined (don't use yet): Contingency. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Argonian
+10 Lockpicking; +5 Alteration, Light Armor, Pickpocket, Restoration, Sneak; disease resistance, waterbreathing, stronger punches. Histskin rapidly restores Health.

Faster swimming, waterbreathing, post-swim stealth/speed, low-resource recovery. Caustic Spit strips armor and magic resistance. Innate disease resistance is gone. No quarantined power; co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Wood Elf
+10 Archery; +5 Alchemy, Light Armor, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Sneak; poison/disease resistance. Command Animal temporarily recruits an animal.

Eat corpses for attributes; Harrier marks prey and weakens foes; sense movement while still. Beast Tongue recruits animals. Loses innate poison/disease resistance. Quarantined (don't use yet): Beast Tongue. Harrier's effects for friends and racial unlocks (not verified).
Breton
+10 Conjuration; +5 Alchemy, Alteration, Illusion, Restoration, Speech; 25% magic resistance, Conjure Familiar. Dragonskin temporarily absorbs hostile spells.

15% magic resistance, low-Magicka absorption; special standing-stone bonuses; Grail boosts recovery. Shared Ancestry borrows human or elven racial powers. Borrowed powers keep their quarantines. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Dark Elf
+10 Destruction; +5 Alchemy, Alteration, Illusion, Light Armor, Sneak; 50% fire resistance, Sparks. Ancestor's Wrath burns nearby enemies.

25% fire resistance; spending Spirit Favor grants armor and further resistance. Whispers marks victims for rewards. Spirit Walk spends Favor to summon ancestors. Quarantined (don't use yet): Spirit Walk. Whispers rewards and racial unlocks in co-op (not verified).
Imperial
+10 Restoration; +5 Block, Destruction, Enchanting, Heavy Armor, One-Handed; Imperial Luck finds gold. Voice of the Emperor calms nearby people.

Discipline boosts nearby allies' armor/damage; random resource regeneration in combat; permanent attribute/resistance/skill tradeoffs. Colovian Star refills and temporarily boosts Magicka and Stamina. Discipline's benefit to players (not verified); do not count on it as a party buff.
Khajiit
+10 Sneak; +5 Alchemy, Archery, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, One-Handed; stronger claws. Night Eye grants repeatable night vision.

Faster movement; sprinting costs extra Stamina. Quieter sneaking, Prowl leaps, stronger claw power attacks. Perception grants night vision and dampens sounds. No quarantined power; co-op movement and racial unlocks (not verified).
Nord
+10 Two-Handed; +5 Block, Light Armor, One-Handed, Smithing, Speech; 50% frost resistance. Battle Cry makes nearby enemies flee.

25% frost resistance; choose racial enemies for damage bonuses; missing Health strengthens attacks/spells. Avatar restores Magicka/Stamina and adds frost resistance. No quarantined power; co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Orc
+10 Heavy Armor; +5 Block, Enchanting, One-Handed, Smithing, Two-Handed; stronghold access. Berserker Rage doubles physical damage dealt and halves damage received.

Bloodlust briefly boosts speed/recovery; Shockwave staggers; gear strengthens but enchantments weaken. Berserk boosts attacks and reduces spell costs; may trigger randomly. No quarantined power; co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
Redguard
+10 One-Handed; +5 Alteration, Archery, Block, Destruction, Smithing; 50% poison resistance. Adrenaline Rush rapidly restores Stamina.

Disease resistance replaces poison resistance; unlimited travel Stamina, recovery when injured, kill bonuses. Red Sand Dance slows time while sprinting. Quarantined (don't use yet): Red Sand Dance. Co-op racial effects and unlocks (not verified).
blocks.note: Imperious is part of our collection (revision 6). Its racial powers unlock through racial objectives, not at character creation.

blocks.title: Replacement, not extra bonuses
blocks.text: Imperious bonuses replace vanilla. Powers need racial objectives; NPCs receive abilities. Untested means not tested yet.

blocks.title: Check exact ranks in search
blocks.text: Quarantined (don't use yet): Dark Souls 2; Dragonborn rank 4 drum/rank 5 merchant powers. Strong Reflexes: Block 30 rank 1 allowed; Block 50 rank 2 quarantined (don't use yet).

sections.title: Find your kind of magic
sections.intro: Mysticism adds spells across all five schools. Better Vanilla Perks changes some spells and summon strength.

quickAnswers.label: SCHOOLS
quickAnswers.text: Five schools; no new skill tree.

quickAnswers.label: TRAVEL
quickAnswers.text: Mark and Recall are quarantined (don't use yet).

items.title: Start with familiar spells
items.text: Mysticism rebalances spells and adds choices. Buy tomes from usual vendors. Read each tooltip and try direct spells first. Some spells use Better Vanilla Perks instead.

items.title: Conjure; don't raise bodies
items.text: Summoning a skeleton differs from raising a corpse. We're testing one summon each. The game allows more. Extra perks don't change our rule. Conjure Familiar has Better Vanilla Perks' effect. Potent flame/frost/storm atronachs and thralls use its strength.

items.title: Heal a friend
items.text: Start with Healing Hands, Heal Other or Grand Healing. Ordinary healing and Courage, Rally and Call to Arms have player-target support; exact targeting, experience and perk scaling are not tested yet.

items.title: Know your support limits
items.text: Custom auras and undead-healing spells are not automatically player heals. Imperial Discipline is not a heal. Staff builds are welcome; extra staff skill experience is not included.

blocks.title: Five magic schools
rows: Alteration
Flesh armor, light, detection, Telekinesis and Transmute; Paralyze and Mass Paralysis belong here.

Burden slows enemies; Corrode Armor weakens armor; Feather increases carrying capacity; Sea Stride allows water-walking. Paralysis moves to Illusion. No named spell quarantine here. Mark and Recall belong to Conjuration. Better Vanilla Perks: Candlelight and its scroll last 120 seconds.
Conjuration
Bound weapons, familiars, atronachs, Dremora and corpse raising; Dawnguard adds Soul Cairn undead summons.

Adds Skeleton summons, more bound weapons, Daedric Cure for summons, and Expert travel spells Mark and Recall. Quarantined (don't use yet): Mark, Recall and corpse raising. Keep one active summon per player. Conjure Familiar has Better Vanilla Perks' effect. Potent flame/frost/storm atronachs and thralls use its strength.
Destruction
Fire, frost and shock attacks; vampires can absorb Health using Vampiric Drain.

Burning Touch adds close-range fire; Greater Flames extends continuous attacks. Vampiric Touch, Vampiric Bolt and Blood Lance steal living enemies' Health. No named spell quarantine; exact co-op effects (not verified). Flames and Frostbite each have one effect. Either hand uses Better Vanilla Perks. Mysticism's extra effects are absent. Sparks casts using Better Vanilla Perks. Its strength and duration match Mysticism.
Illusion
Calm, fear, frenzy, morale, Muffle and Invisibility; paralysis is an Alteration effect.

Paralyze moves here; Silence stops enemy casting; Command controls NPCs; Night Eye grants dark vision; Ghostwalk refreshes invisibility after it breaks. Enemy-control spells cannot control human players. Exact co-op effects (not verified).
Restoration
Healing Hands channels healing onto NPCs; Heal Other gives an Adept burst. Grand Healing is an Expert area burst.

Heal Other becomes Apprentice; Close Greater Wounds adds Adept area healing. Grand Healing stays Expert but channels. Sunbeam damages undead; Circle of Life heals. Ordinary healing allowed. Player healing amounts, circle effects and Resurgence bonuses (not verified). Stendarr's Aura, its light, Poison Rune: Better Vanilla Perks effects.
blocks.note: Mysticism and Better Vanilla Perks both shape our spells. Not tested in co-op yet. Collection revision 6.

blocks.title: Main Mysticism only
blocks.text: Quarantined (don't use yet): Mark, Recall and corpse reanimation.

sections.title: Can I use this?
sections.intro: Check mod and rank. Every quarantine is agreed; unknown means unverified.
